name: Uyrh no Shohousen
original_name: ウーユリーフの処方箋
source:
A cursed otome game named "Uyrh no Shohousen".
Every hot guy that has the game installed on his phone will eventually dissappear.
Matsuri, a college student that only sees women as pawns, has the game installed on his phone and enters the world of the game.
However, that world is nothing like he thought it'd be...
translation:
有一款名为《乌尤利夫的处方笺》的诅咒乙女游戏。
凡是手机上安装了这款游戏的帅哥，最终都会消失。
把女人都当作棋子的大学生祭，也在手机上安装了这款游戏，并进入了游戏世界。
然而，那个世界与他想象中的截然不同……
